fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-08-22 states that the complainant discovered that a gas stove and utensils had been taken from a place near Mynthan Colony Main Street, on 2025-08-22 at roughly 09:20. Contact details given by the complainant, Nithin Balan, include the number 9000000470. The complaint refers to Madhan Palanisamy, a driver, reachable on 9000000295. The complaint mentions Thirumal Velan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000384, in connection with the events. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents, CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Items reportedly taken while the premises were unattended.
